system.longDesc:
Capacity: 1 Slot

An implanted storage device creates a “backup file” for your brain. So long as the device itself survives, your memories and personality up to that point can be downloaded (or “re-sleeved”) into a new brain and body, if it is provided. How long this takes depends on the setting but, essentially, so long as your brain backup is intact, you cannot permanently die. The wealthy might have any number of “spare” clone bodies on-hand for when they need a back-up while those with fewer Resources might have to make-do with whatever body becomes available. The time involved in a “brain restore” to a new body can also vary from months to weeks or even hours or less. The Game Master chooses these limits, and any others associated with the technology. For an additional enhancement, your brain backup also transmits a copy to “offsite” storage elsewhere, ensuring your survival (up to the point of your last backup) even if the device in your body is destroyed, so long as the offsite backup survives.
